day-view.loading.meaning: Says, to a screen reader, that the Cadence day view in an AI client is waiting for the day. Sighted people see placeholder rows.

day-view.unavailable.meaning: Says the Cadence day view could not reach the AI client that opened it, or got no day from Cadence.
day-view.unavailable.text: This view could not load the day. Ask for the day again.

day-view.empty.meaning: Says in the Cadence day view that the day has no Occurrences.
day-view.empty.text: Nothing is scheduled for this day.

day-view.needs-decision.meaning: Counts, in the Cadence day view, the earlier Unresolved items in Needs decision. It is a count only; the view lists none of them.
day-view.needs-decision.text: {truncated, select, yes {More than {count} earlier items need a decision} other {{count, plural, one {# earlier item needs a decision} other {# earlier items need a decision}}}}

day-view.reconnect.meaning: Stands in place of the Completed, Not Completed and Note controls in the Cadence day view when the AI client's access does not include changes.

day-view.from-source.meaning: Marks, in the Cadence day view, a Completed row that a connected service marked, so it does not read as the person's own mark.

day-view.added.meaning: Marks, in the Cadence day view, a row that was added to the day from the person's opportunities, and who added it.
day-view.added.text: {source, select, daily_brief {Added from Daily Brief} chat {Added in Chat} mcp {Added by a connected app} other {Added}}

day-view.alongside.meaning: Marks, in the Cadence day view, a row whose Behavior the person set as alongside. A guess is never shown.

day-view.conflict.meaning: Refuses a change from the Cadence day view because the item changed somewhere else first. The view has reloaded the day.
day-view.conflict.text: This changed somewhere else. Check it and try again.
day-view.conflict.label: Not changed

day-view.note-current.meaning: Introduces the saved note above the open note editor in the Cadence day view after a refused note save, so the person can compare before saving again.

day-view.rate-limited.meaning: Refuses a change from the Cadence day view because the AI client made too many changes, and says how long to wait.
day-view.rate-limited.text: Too many changes for now. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
day-view.rate-limited.label: Not changed

day-view.not-saved.meaning: Says a change from the Cadence day view did not reach Cadence, or the AI client declined to send it.
day-view.not-saved.text: Cadence could not save that. Try again.
day-view.not-saved.label: Not changed

day-view.reload-failed.meaning: Says a change from the Cadence day view was saved but the view could not read the day again, so its rows may be old.
day-view.reload-failed.text: Saved. The day did not reload, so this view may be out of date.
day-view.reload-failed.label: Out of date
